(사진=인텔코리아) 인공지능(AI) 반도체 기업 딥엑스가 전날 서울 코엑스에서 인텔코리아와 AI 반도체 기술 협력을 위한 업무협약(MOU)을 체결했다고 13일 밝혔다. AI 추론 소프트웨어 오픈비노와 딥엑스 신경망처리장치(NPU) 연동 및 최적화 방안을 공동으로 모색한다. 같은 날 인텔코리아 및 국내 서버 전문기업 KTNF와 별도의 3자 업무협약도 체결해 AI 반도체부터 소프트웨어, 서버 시스템에 이르는 협력 범위를 확대할 계획이다. 딥엑스와 인텔코리아는 이번 협약을 통해 인텔의 컴퓨팅 플랫폼 및 소프트웨어 생태계를 활용해 딥엑스의 신경망처리장치(NPU) 기술을 진전시키는 한편, AI 추론 솔루션의 개발과 활용 위한 협력 방안을 모색하기로 했다. 양사의 주요 협력 분야는 △인텔 OpenVINO와 딥엑스 NPU 연동 및 최적화 △피지컬 AI·엣지 AI 플랫폼 기술 협력 △AI 반도체 및 시스템 아키텍처 관련 기술적 검증 △DX-M2 기반 생성형 AI 솔루션 검토 등이다. 피지컬 AI 분야에서는 인텔 x86 프로세서의 호스트·제어 기능과 딥엑스 NPU의 인지·추론 기능을 결합한 플랫폼의 기술적 가능성을 검증하고, 로봇 분야에서의 시연·적용 확대 방안을 모색한다. 박유민 기자 newmin@etnews.com

items.fullText: AI·SW AI 델, AMD 6세대 EPYC 탑재 서버 출시…기존 데이터센터서 AI·HPC 성능 높인다 발행일 : 2026-11-13 10:34 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 파워엣지 R9825·R9815 공개…최대 512코어 지원, 공랭식 기반 컴퓨팅 집적도 강화 서버 통합으로 전력·냉각·소프트웨어 라이선스 비용 절감…액체 냉각·PCIe Gen6도 지원 델 파워엣지 R9825. 델 테크놀로지스(Dell Technologies)가 AMD 6세대 에픽(EPYC) 프로세서를 탑재한 차세대 서버 2종을 출시하며 기업용 인공지능(AI) 및 고성능 컴퓨팅(HPC) 인프라 시장 공략을 강화한다. 기존 데이터센터의 공랭식 설비와 랙 환경을 유지하면서도 컴퓨팅 집적도를 높이고, 서버 통합을 통해 인프라 운영비용까지 절감할 수 있도록 설계한 것이 특징이다. 델 테크놀로지스는 AMD EPYC 9006 SP7 프로세서를 탑재한 '델 파워엣지 R9825(Dell PowerEdge R9825)'와 '델 파워엣지 R9815(Dell PowerEdge R9815)'를 선보였다. 두 제품 모두 공랭식을 기본으로 지원하며, 워크로드와 데이터센터 환경에 따라 직접 액체 냉각(DLC) 방식으로 확장할 수 있다. 신제품은 AI 추론과 에이전트 기반 오케스트레이션, HPC 등 연산 집약적인 워크로드가 증가하는 상황에서 기존 데이터센터 인프라를 전면 교체하지 않고도 성능을 끌어올리는 데 초점을 맞췄다. 대규모 데이터센터 재설계와 냉각 설비 투자 부담을 줄이면서 차세대 컴퓨팅 환경으로 전환할 수 있도록 한 것이다. 듀얼 소켓 3U 규격의 파워엣지 R9825는 여러 고성능 워크로드를 동시에 처리하는 스케일업 환경에 최적화했다. 서버당 최대 512코어를 제공해 AI 에이전트 운영과 범용 컴퓨팅 수요에 대응한다. 싱글 소켓 2U 규격의 파워엣지 R9815는 소켓당 성능을 극대화해 기존 듀얼 소켓 서버가 담당하던 워크로드까지 수용할 수 있도록 설계했다. 두 제품에 탑재된 AMD EPYC 9006 SP7 프로세서는 소켓당 최대 256코어와 최대 600W 구성 가능한 열 설계 전력(TDP)을 지원한다. 특히 R9825는 공기 흐름 효율을 높인 3U 섀시를 적용해 기존 랙 공간에서 컴퓨팅 밀도를 높일 수 있다. 델에 따르면 약 33kW의 전력을 사용하는 42U 랙 환경에서 R9825와 같은 듀얼 소켓 3U 플랫폼은 동일한 랙 전력을 소비하는 동급 2U 서버 구성보다 최대 1024개의 코어를 추가로 제공할 수 있다. 데이터센터 전력 공급과 냉각 인프라를 크게 변경하지 않고도 연산 자원을 확충할 수 있다는 설명이다. 서버 통합에 따른 비용 절감 효과도 주요 경쟁력으로 내세웠다. 데이터센터 운영비용은 서버 전력뿐만 아니라 랙 공간과 냉각 설비, 소프트웨어 라이선스 등 다양한 요소에 영향을 받는다. 소켓이나 서버 수를 기준으로 과금하는 소프트웨어의 경우 서버 통합을 통해 라이선스 비용을 줄일 수 있다. 델 파워엣지 R9815. R9815는 싱글 소켓 구성으로 기존 듀얼 소켓 시스템이 필요했던 워크로드까지 처리하도록 설계됐다. 물리적인 서버 대수를 줄이는 동시에 라이선스 산정 기준이 되는 소켓 및 서버 수를 최적화할 수 있어 총소유비용(TCO) 절감에 유리하다. R9825는 고밀도 듀얼 소켓 구성으로 다수의 고성능 워크로드를 하나의 플랫폼에 통합하는 역할을 맡는다. AI 및 HPC 인프라 확장을 위한 스토리지 연계 전략도 제시했다. 델은 R9815에 자사 엑사스케일 스토리지(Dell Exascale Storage)를 결합해 기업이 향후 데이터 처리량과 워크로드 증가에 대응할 수 있도록 지원한다는 방침이다. 냉각 기술과 관리 체계의 유연성도 강화했다. 공랭식으로 운영하다가 필요에 따라 직접 액체 냉각으로 전환할 수 있도록 해 데이터센터 냉각 전략 변화에 대응한다. 통합 원격 관리 솔루션인 iDRAC 10과 오픈매니지 엔터프라이즈(OpenManage Enterprise)를

The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.d: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
items.fullText: Nvidia co-founder and now former CEO Jensen Huang has never been as flashy or controversy-prone as AI leaders like OpenAI’s Sam Altman or SpaceXAI’s Elon Musk. Now, the 63-year-old industry kingpin has admitted that he cheated on his wife of 40 years in affairs that could have ramifications beyond Huang’s personal life and U.S. national security. U.S. officials believe that one of Huang’s likely romantic interests, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy who has been feeding information back to Beijing. (Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, is of no relation to Jensen Huang.) Megaspeed is a Singapore-based AI infrastructure company that reportedly purchased $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips over the last two years. The U.S. and Singapore have both previously investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm was illegally sharing chips with China. The Justice Department has since taken over the federal investigation into the company, The New York Times has reported. The story took a sudden new turn on Wednesday. Citing five people who worked at Nvidia, the Times reported that Huang also had an extramarital relationship with Kimberly Powell, the company’s vice president of healthcare, who reports directly to him. Nvidia, Huang, and Powell have not confirmed the report. Reached by a Times reporter, Huang reportedly said, “I don’t think you should be talking to me directly,” before hanging up. By early Thursday morning, Huang was no longer CEO of the company he co-founded 33 years ago. Then, Thursday afternoon, Reuters dropped another bombshell, publishing a report alleging that Huang had yet another extramarital affair with another unnamed Nvidia employee. The U.S. and China are embroiled in a fierce technological arms race to build the most advanced AI infrastructure, which could shape each country’s economic future, military prowess, and capacity for innovation. items.t: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
items.d: Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans, even as delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model.
items.fullText: In its third-quarter earnings call Thursday, the neocloud company Nebius laid out $40 billion in planned spending for 2027, far more than Wall Street had expected. It’s an ambitious plan, but it rests on a string of planned projects that are already starting to show cracks. Nebius plans to fund the buildout by relying on customer pre-payments and loans backed by customer contracts — essentially using the future value of its data centers to finance their construction. But that can be a risky strategy if those projects get bogged down by delays or cancellations. “Building at this scale is hard, and delays are part of our industry right now,” CEO Arkady Volozh said during Thursday’s earnings call. “We are not immune.” The earnings announcement comes on the heels of reports that Microsoft is cooling on neocloud deals that aren’t delivering on time. That’s a problem for companies like Nebius, whose financing strategy is becoming more dependent on repayments. Because if it can’t get to capacity on time, it will keep piling on costs while revenues slip. One of Nebius’ largest customers is Microsoft, which is paying for AI computing capacity at a Vineland, New Jersey, data center that is now months behind schedule. Nebius’ contract with Microsoft is worth up to $19.4 billion, but it’s already letting deadlines slip. Only just over half of the Microsoft capacity is now planned for delivery by the end of the year, with the rest coming in Q2 2027. The delay is because DataOne, the third-party operator of the site, “decided to wind down the temporary generation faster than it was expected,” according to Andrey Korolenko, chief product and infrastructure officer, as the site switches over to Bloom Energy fuel cells. Still, that transition wasn’t entirely by choice. items.t: SoftBank’s billion-dollar loss may have put a cap on AI’s natural gas ambitions
items.d: SoftBank lost over $3 billion preordering natural gas turbines to power AI data centers. Here's what the loss means to power markets.
items.fullText: SoftBank might not be the first to invest in a hot trend, but when it does, it goes big. Witness its $30 billion bet on OpenAI in early 2025 or its announcement in February that its SB Energy subsidiary would spend $33 billion on a 9.2-gigawatt natural gas power plant. If you can’t be first, be biggest, I guess. That philosophy apparently spilled over into procurement, where orders were also supersized. Starting about two years ago, SoftBank reportedly put down deposits on more than 13 gigawatts of turbines, almost 50% more than it needed. The decision to over-order undoubtedly helped secure turbines and speed up SoftBank’s projects. “SB Energy did not have a choice except to overbook turbines in the future if they wanted some turbines right away,” Peter Gardett, CEO of Noreva , told TechCrunch via email. The energy world was caught off guard by the swiftness and magnitude of AI’s rising power demands. Queues for turbine orders now extend into the early 2030s . As natural gas was shaping up to be a go-to power source for the AI boom, CEO Masayoshi Son bet that by deploying his investment firm’s significant war chest, he could corner a portion of the market. If the AI world wanted power for its data centers, it would have to come to him. Now that bet appears to have fizzled. SoftBank announced a $7.1 billion quarterly loss on Tuesday, with over half of that stemming from losses related to power-generating equipment. The investor had paid turbine manufacturers nonrefundable deposits to secure orders, and now it considered much of those worthless. The move was also a costly bit of price discovery, Gardett said. Rather than overpay and potentially still be short of turbines, SoftBank overpaid and over-ordered. “This charge is just that price discovery finally happening,” Gardett said. items.fullText: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Contribution and New AI Infrastructure At KubeCon, NVIDIA is putting tools to secure agents and run AI on Kubernetes in the hands of the cloud-native community. November 10, 2026 by Warren Barkley 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Kubernetes, the open source system that manages how applications run across thousands of AI factories, has become the foundation for AI, and the demands on it are only growing. To help meet them, NVIDIA is deepening its commitment to open source at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon , the flagship conference for the Kubernetes and cloud-native communities. NVIDIA is contributing NVIDIA OpenShell , an open source runtime for securing and governing autonomous agents, to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF), a nonprofit that is part of the Linux Foundation and the host of KubeCon. As a CNCF Sandbox project, OpenShell will be governed by the organizations building it into their products and strengthened by the expertise of security professionals worldwide. NVIDIA is also contributing to Agent Substrate , an open source Google-led framework for operating long-running agent workloads at scale on Kubernetes that has been accepted into the CNCF Sandbox. Additionally, NVIDIA announced new components of the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform : NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine , NVIDIA Kubernetes Recipes and NVIDIA Snapshot . These tools help teams deploy, manage and scale GPU infrastructure on Kubernetes for AI factories. Together, these advancements mark a step forward in making Kubernetes the leading foundation for AI workloads at scale — empowering developers to build safer, more efficient AI infrastructure for the future. items.fullText: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum November 9, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA hosted the MSIT -NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum at COEX. Representatives from the Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA met with over 20 Korean startups across foundation models, physical AI, AI infrastructure and AI semiconductors. NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2 , with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies , RLWRLD and Upstage. Point2 Technology, an AI interconnect company, builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories, offering an innovative alternative to conventional copper and optical interconnect solutions for AI cluster scale-up, delivering the reach, performance and efficiency needed for next-generation AI infrastructure. Motif Technologies , a Seoul-based AI lab, develops foundation models for building AI agents that carry out complex tasks, including Motif-3, a large language model released with open weights. RLWRLD, a physical AI startup based in San Francisco, Seoul and Tokyo, develops robotics foundation models that enable humanoid and industrial robots to perform complex real-world tasks that require five-finger dexterity, such as precisely inserting components, threading nuts onto bolts and kitting parts from moving conveyors. Upstage , a Korean enterprise AI company, develops Solar language models and document AI tools that help businesses extract information from complex documents, streamline workflows and build AI applications for everyday operations. The companies represent work across the full AI stack , from infrastructure to models to robotics applications. items.fullText: From Chips to Skills, NVIDIA and Korea Expand Sovereign AI Collaboration November 8, 2026 by Jesse Clayton 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA and Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) are expanding their collaboration across the country’s sovereign AI ecosystem, from AI semiconductors and data center infrastructure to talent, startups, models, agents and security. The collaboration lays the groundwork for Korean NPU and XPU companies to explore participation in the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, and includes NVIDIA training and certification programs, hackathons and technical seminars to strengthen GPU utilization. Through Korea’s AI for All initiative, NVIDIA will collaborate with three selected consortia and four leading Korean foundation model builders, using NVIDIA Dynamo software to optimize and scale AI inference. In addition, NVIDIA today announced a collaboration with SK Telecom and Rebellions, supported by MSIT, to advance sovereign AI infrastructure for Korean models and workloads with NVIDIA NVLink Fusion.
